top_signals.title: Oil Rally Fuels Inflation Fears; Canada's US Tariffs Kick In
top_signals.summary: US equity futures waver and global stocks slide as brent crude inches closer to $100 a barrel, adding to inflation concerns. Saudi Arabia halts some energy operations after attacks. Canada's retaliatory levies of up to 50% on US goods take effect. ASML wins TSMC and Samsung's commitment to use its latest chip production gear. Marija Veitmane of State Street joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss market risks ahead of the CPI report later in the week.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Ivanhoe Talking to Big Tech as Congo Copper Project Expands
top_signals.summary: Mining tycoon Robert Friedland said he’s fielding “unconventional interest,” including from US Big Tech, in Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.’s fast-expanding copper exploration project in the Democratic Republic of Congo, highlighting growing anxieties about future supplies of the key metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
